notes: Reached kare.de only through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in a dedicated tab; all category reads were same-origin fetch() from the loaded kare.de page context (no curl/proxy/WebFetch). robots.txt fetched the same way: 'User-agent: *' + 'Allow: /', no Claude/anthropic/ClaudeBot-specific rule anywhere in the 7433-byte file. Platform is the custom Nuxt/Vue storefront described in the prior Home-Decor pass; URL shape /c/<slug> unchanged. TREE SOURCE: /sitemap.xml -> /sitemap_categories.xml (172 category URLs, emitted in tree order) gave the candidate set; the authoritative parent/child edges came from each category page's own 'Kategorien in "X"' tile block, which I parsed structurally (the H5 heading's parent div) from the SSR HTML of every node, walking breadth-first from /c/moebel. 77 nodes were walked; the furniture tree bottoms out at depth 3. The mega-menu only exposes 11 children of MOEBEL, but the category page exposes 14 (it adds Bars, Hocker and Paravents), so the tile block, not the menu, was used. QTY SOURCE: the site's own rendered listing header 'N Produkte' (server-rendered into the HTML, so the fetched HTML and the live DOM carry the same string). Verified by loading three pages for real in the tab and reading document.body.innerText: Garderoben '85 Produkte | 1 von 2', Esszimmerstuehle '83 Produkte | 1 von 2', Schuhschraenke '48 Produkte' - all matched the parsed value exactly. Counts also matched the page's embedded Nuxt 'pagination:{count:N}' object wherever that object was not minified away. Categories showing 'Keine Produkte gefunden!' are emitted with qty 0 (a real answer), not null: Seat Cushions & Poufs, Dining Benches, Folding Chairs. Nothing was estimated, summed or inherited; there are no null qty rows. DEDUP: /c/barhocker (under Hocker) and /c/barstuehle-hocker (under Stuehle) both report 15 and were product-ID verified as the identical listing (15/15 identical /p/ hrefs, same order) - the Stuehle-branch duplicate was dropped and Bar Stools is emitted once, under Stools. EXCLUDED, with reasons: Spiegel (Mirrors, 113) and all four of its children (Wandspiegel 103, Standspiegel 5, Tischspiegel 3, Spiegel mit Beleuchtung 0) - the site files Spiegel inside MOEBEL, but mirrors are Wall Decor's scope per the brief; Matratzen & Lattenroste (7) - mattresses and slatted bed bases are bedding, not furniture; Schirmstaender (Umbrella Stands, 0) - a hall accessory, not furniture; the WOHNBEREICHE room roll-ups (Wohnzimmer/Schlafzimmer/Esszimmer/Buero & Arbeitszimmer 253/Flur/Kueche/Balkon & Garten 85) - each mixes furniture with lighting, decor and textiles and has no crawlable per-type child, and the type-based MOEBEL branches already cover their furniture; the couchtische-rund / -holz / -weiss / -glas / -schwarz / -metall / -marmor / -gold slugs in the sitemap (colour and material filter pages); Neuheiten / Bestseller / Sale / Design-Geschenke and the other marketing rails. OUTDOOR: Gartenmoebel (66) is the only genuine outdoor-furniture listing; it lives under WOHNBEREICHE > Balkon & Garten (its siblings are Gartenaccessoires and Outdoor-Beleuchtung, both out of scope) and has no children, so it is emitted as a single leaf under the top bucket 'Outdoor Furniture'. Gartenstuehle (10) is separately emitted under MOEBEL > Stuehle because that is where the site itself parents it; it very likely overlaps Gartenmoebel, so do not add the two together. SANITY CHECKS: counts differ per category (no site-wide constant), no suspiciously round display caps, every h1 matched the slug requested (no silent parent fallback), and no drift was seen between the BFS read and the later verification read of the same pages. One site-side inconsistency worth knowing: KARE's own parent totals are not supersets of their children - Schuhschraenke reports 48 while its parent Schraenke reports 39, and Garderoben reports 85 against 29 across its three children. Each page's own header is still the site's own reported number for that URL, which is what is recorded; parents are emitted as grouping rows per the deepest-URL rule, so some parent-level residue is not represented by any leaf.
